look_here_first: Inspect several mature leaves from one branch: water oak commonly has a narrow wedge-shaped base and a broader, often shallowly three-lobed bristle-tipped apex. Confirm small second-year acorns in shallow cups.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: variable small wedge- to spatula-shaped leaves, often widest near the tip

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaf apex frequently shallowly three-lobed with minute bristle tips

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: small acorns with shallow scaly cups; acorns mature in two seasons

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: deciduous to tardily deciduous bottomland red oak
